en.title: Best VR Headsets 2026
en.description: Valve's Steam Frame cleared customs, Meta raised Quest prices $100, and the Index is gone. Here is where every VR headset worth buying actually lands in August 2026.

zh-tw.title: 最佳 VR 頭戴裝置 2026
zh-tw.description: Steam Frame 已經過了美國海關，Meta 四月把 Quest 全線漲一百美元，Index 停產。2026 年八月值得買的 VR 頭戴裝置，這份排行幫你重新排好。

en.description: Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 standalone headset with pancake lenses, 2064x2208 per eye, and full-color passthrough. It runs the biggest content library in VR on its own and streams SteamVR wirelessly over Air Link when you plug into a gaming PC.

zh-tw.description: 搭 Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 的一體機，pancake 鏡片，單眼 2064x2208，彩色透視。開機就能玩 VR 最大的遊戲庫，想接 PC 也能用 Air Link 無線串 SteamVR。台灣沒有官方代理，蝦皮跟日本代購是主要入手管道。

en.description: The same XR2 Gen 2 chip and the same full Quest software library as the Quest 3, using Fresnel lenses and 1832x1920 panels to hit the lowest price of any current-generation headset with color mixed reality.

zh-tw.description: 晶片跟 Quest 3 一樣是 XR2 Gen 2，軟體庫也完全一樣，改用 Fresnel 鏡片與 1832x1920 面板把價格壓到現世代最低，彩色混合實境照樣有。想先試水溫的話這台最合理。

en.description: Valve's streaming-first SteamOS headset with dual 2160x2160 LCD panels at 72 to 144Hz, Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 with 16GB of RAM, eye-tracked foveated streaming, and a bundled 6GHz wireless adapter that keeps VR traffic on its own radio. FCC certified, stock has cleared US customs, price and date still unannounced.

zh-tw.description: Valve 的串流優先 SteamOS 頭戴裝置，雙眼 2160x2160 LCD、72 至 144Hz，Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 配 16GB RAM，眼動追蹤中央窩串流，還附一個 6GHz 無線傳輸器讓 VR 走自己的頻道。FCC 已過認證，貨也進了美國倉庫，價格跟日期還沒公布。

en.description: Dual 2000x2040 OLED panels with HDR, eye tracking, and headset haptics, driven by a PS5 over a single USB-C cable. A PC adapter opens up SteamVR for owners who also game on desktop.

zh-tw.description: 雙眼 2000x2040 OLED 支援 HDR，有眼動追蹤跟頭戴震動，一條 USB-C 接 PS5 就能用。另外買 PC 轉接器還能跑 SteamVR。台灣有官方定價，通路好找，保固也單純。

en.description: A 107-gram wired PC VR headset with 2560x2560 micro-OLED panels per eye, 116-degree horizontal field of view, and a face gasket custom-moulded from a phone scan of your face. The 2e variant adds eye tracking for $1,219.

zh-tw.description: 只有 107 公克的有線 PC VR 頭戴裝置，單眼 2560x2560 micro-OLED，水平視野 116 度，臉部墊片是用手機掃你的臉客製出來的。加眼動追蹤的 2e 版本 1,219 美元。要 Lighthouse 基地台才能跑。

en.description: ByteDance's standalone headset with Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2, 2160x2160 per eye, 8MP colour passthrough cameras, and a balanced rear-battery strap in the box. Sold across Europe and Asia rather than the US.

zh-tw.description: 字節跳動的一體機，Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2，單眼 2160x2160，8MP 彩色透視鏡頭，盒裝就附後置電池頭帶配重。主打歐洲跟亞洲市場，美國買不到。

en.description: A convertible headset that runs standalone on Snapdragon XR2 Gen 1 and switches to a glasses-style form factor when tethered for PC VR. Diopter dials let glasses wearers go without lenses, and it regularly sells near $799.

zh-tw.description: 可變形的頭戴裝置，一體機模式跑 Snapdragon XR2 Gen 1，接 PC 時可以拆成眼鏡形態。內建屈光度調整旋鈕，近視的人不用戴眼鏡進去。HTC 是台灣品牌，保固維修最好處理。

en.description: An enthusiast PC VR headset built around 3840x3840 QLED panels at 50 or 57 pixels per degree with swappable optical engines, aimed squarely at flight and racing simulator players who want to read cockpit instruments. The micro-OLED engine lists at $2,000.

zh-tw.description: 發燒級 PC VR 頭戴裝置，3840x3840 QLED 面板，每度 50 或 57 像素，光學模組可換。目標客群就是飛行模擬跟賽車模擬玩家，要的是座艙儀表看得清楚。micro-OLED 模組版本 2,000 美元。

en.description: An Android-based standalone headset with 3840x3552 micro-OLED panels per eye, Snapdragon XR2+ Gen 2, hand and eye tracking, and a 3D spatial camera. The 1TB configuration lists at $2,300.

zh-tw.description: 跑 Android 的一體機，單眼 3840x3552 micro-OLED，Snapdragon XR2+ Gen 2，有手勢跟眼動追蹤，還內建 3D 空間攝影機。1TB 版本 2,300 美元。規格漂亮，軟體生態還在起步。

en.description: Apple's spatial computer with 23 million micro-OLED pixels, the M5 chip, and visionOS. It went from $3,499 to $3,699 in June 2026 on memory costs, and it is the sharpest display on this list by a wide margin.

zh-tw.description: Apple 的空間運算裝置，2300 萬 micro-OLED 像素，M5 晶片，跑 visionOS。2026 年 6 月因為記憶體成本從 3,499 漲到 3,699 美元。畫面清晰度在這張表上遙遙領先，價格也是。

en.commentary:
Meta Quest 3 is still the headset I hand to almost everyone in August 2026, and the April price hike changes the maths less than the headlines suggest. At $599 it runs the largest content library in VR standalone, handles colour passthrough well enough that mixed reality apps are genuinely usable, and streams SteamVR wirelessly over Air Link the moment you point it at a gaming PC. One device covering all three jobs is worth more than any single spec on this page.

Steam Frame is the most interesting hardware of the year and I have still ranked it third. Valve has cleared roughly 35 tons of it through US customs, published the FCC filings, and switched on the Great on Frame store section. It has named neither a price nor a date. Retailer signals point at $899 to $1,199. At $899, dual 2160x2160 panels at 144Hz plus eye-tracked foveated streaming over a bundled 6GHz adapter takes the PC VR crown outright. At $1,199 it becomes a specialist buy for people who already own a strong gaming PC. I scored the hardware on what it demonstrably does and held the value column back until Valve says the number, and I will move it the day they do.

The memory crunch is the story underneath every price on this list. Quest 3 went up $100 in April, Quest 3S went up $50, Vision Pro went from $3,499 to $3,699 in June, and Valve's own Steam Machine landed at $1,049. Anyone waiting for VR hardware to drift down through the autumn should buy now instead.

One note on how to read the table. The standalone column drags tethered headsets down hard, so Bigscreen Beyond 2 and Pimax Crystal Super sit lower overall than their reputation among enthusiasts. Sim racers and flight sim pilots should read the PC VR and comfort columns and ignore the overall score entirely. A 107-gram headset you can wear for a four-hour endurance race is a specific answer to a specific question, and Beyond 2 answers it better than anything else here.

highlights.title: Quest 3 at $599 still wins on the only metric that matters: how many nights you actually use it
highlights.body: Specs get argued about online, and usage decides whether a headset was worth buying. Quest 3 wins because it removes every reason to leave it in the cupboard. It boots in seconds with no base stations, no PC, and no cable. The Quest store carries the deepest catalogue in VR, so there is always something new to play. Colour passthrough is clean enough that you can answer the door or find your drink without taking it off. Then when you do want Half-Life: Alyx at full fidelity, Air Link streams it from a gaming PC over your existing router. Every other headset here asks you to accept a limitation on one of those axes, and $599 buys you all of them at once.

highlights.title: Buy the Steam Frame on the hardware, and wait for Valve to name the price before you commit
highlights.body: The spec sheet is the most complete standalone design anyone has shipped for PC VR. Dual 2160x2160 LCDs at up to 144Hz, Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 with 16GB of RAM, four tracking cameras plus two eye cameras sampling at 80Hz, microSD expansion, and a 6GHz adapter in the box that keeps VR traffic on a dedicated radio so your housemate's download cannot stutter your session. Foveated streaming is the piece I care about most, because it targets bandwidth at the exact patch of pixels your fovea is on and lets a compressed wireless link look far closer to a wired one. All of that lands differently at $899 than at $1,199, and Valve has published everything except the number.

highlights.title: PlayStation VR2 at $399 is the best OLED you can put on your face for the money
highlights.body: Two 2000x2040 OLED panels with HDR give PSVR2 black levels that the LCD headsets above it simply cannot produce, and in a dark space horror title that single property does more for immersion than resolution does. It adds eye tracking and headset haptics, both of which are still rare at any price. The catch is honest and easy to state: it needs a PS5, and Sony's first-party VR output has slowed. For a household that already owns a PS5 and wants Resident Evil Village and Gran Turismo 7 in VR, this is the cheapest OLED route in the category, and Taiwan gets an official NT$13,880 price with normal warranty coverage rather than a grey import.

highlights.title: The memory crisis has already repriced VR, and waiting costs money
highlights.body: DRAM contract prices rose 90 to 95 percent in Q1 2026 and another 58 to 63 percent in Q2, and memory now accounts for roughly 35 percent of PC bill of materials. That flowed straight through to headsets. Meta raised Quest 3 to $599.99 and Quest 3S to $349.99 on 19 April, applying the increase to refurbished stock as well. Apple moved Vision Pro to $3,699 in June and named component costs directly. Valve's Steam Machine shipped at $1,049 against earlier expectations of something cheaper, which is exactly why the Steam Frame estimate keeps creeping toward the top of its range. Every signal points to firmer prices through 2027, so treat today's number as the floor.

zh-tw.commentary:
老實說，2026 年八月要我推薦一台 VR，我第一個講的還是 Meta Quest 3。四月漲了一百美元來到 599 美元，台灣水貨落在快兩萬，聽起來變貴，可是它依然是唯一一台開機就能玩最大遊戲庫、彩色透視做得夠好讓混合實境 App 真的能用、想玩 PC VR 又能用 Air Link 無線串 SteamVR 的機器。一台機器同時把這三件事做完，這個價值比表上任何單項規格都高。

Steam Frame 是今年最讓我期待的硬體，我還是把它排第三。Valve 已經有大約 35 噸的貨過了美國海關，FCC 文件公開，Great on Frame 商店分類也上線了，就是價格跟日期都還沒講。通路訊號指向 899 到 1,199 美元。如果落在 899 美元，雙眼 2160x2160 的 144Hz 面板加上眼動中央窩串流跟盒裝附的 6GHz 傳輸器，PC VR 王座直接是它的。如果落在 1,199 美元，它就變成已經有一台強力遊戲 PC 的人才該考慮的專門機。我先用硬體實際做得到的事情給分，價值那一欄暫時保守，Valve 一公布價格我就會調。

再來講一件影響整張表的事。記憶體漲價已經完整傳導到零售價了，Quest 3 四月漲一百美元，Quest 3S 漲五十，Vision Pro 六月從 3,499 漲到 3,699，Valve 自己的 Steam Machine 開出 1,049 美元。想等秋天降價的人，我的建議很直接，現在就買。

最後提醒一下這張表怎麼看。一體機效能那一欄會把有線機種拉得很低，所以 Bigscreen Beyond 2 跟 Pimax Crystal Super 的總分看起來會低於它們在發燒圈的地位。玩賽車模擬跟飛行模擬的朋友，直接看 PC VR 效能跟配戴舒適度兩欄就好，總分可以完全忽略。一台 107 公克、能戴著跑完四小時耐力賽的頭戴裝置，是針對特定問題的特定答案，這件事 Beyond 2 做得比誰都好。

highlights.title: Quest 3 賣 599 美元還是第一，因為決定值不值得的是你一個月戴幾次
highlights.body: 規格表怎麼吵網路上都有人吵，真正決定這台機器值不值得的，是它最後有沒有一直被拿出來用。Quest 3 贏在它把所有讓你懶得開機的理由都拿掉了。不用基地台、不用接電腦、不用拉線，戴上去幾秒就進系統。Quest 商店的內容量是 VR 裡最深的，永遠有新東西可以玩。彩色透視乾淨到你可以直接去應門或找飲料，不用把頭戴摘下來。等你真的想用最高畫質玩 Half-Life: Alyx，Air Link 從遊戲 PC 走現有的路由器就能串過來。這張表上其他機器都會要你在某一項上妥協，599 美元讓你一次全拿。

highlights.title: Steam Frame 要看硬體下手，但價格公布之前先別急著刷卡
highlights.body: 這份規格表是目前為止最完整的 PC VR 一體機設計。雙眼 2160x2160 LCD 最高 144Hz，Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 配 16GB RAM，四顆追蹤鏡頭加兩顆每秒取樣 80 次的眼動鏡頭，記憶卡可擴充，盒裝附的 6GHz 傳輸器讓 VR 走專屬頻道，室友在下載也不會讓你掉幀。我最在意的是中央窩串流，它把頻寬集中在你視網膜中央窩正在看的那塊像素上，讓壓縮過的無線畫面接近有線的水準。這些東西在 899 美元跟 1,199 美元是完全不同的兩回事，而 Valve 現在什麼都公布了，就是沒公布數字。

highlights.title: PlayStation VR2 賣 399 美元，是這個價位帶戴得到最好的 OLED
highlights.body: 雙眼 2000x2040 OLED 加 HDR，黑色表現是上面那幾台 LCD 機種做不出來的，玩黑暗場景的恐怖遊戲時，這一項對沉浸感的貢獻比解析度大得多。它還有眼動追蹤跟頭戴震動，這兩樣在任何價位都還算稀有。要老實講的限制也很單純，它要有 PS5 才能用，而且 Sony 第一方的 VR 新作出得比較慢了。家裡已經有 PS5、想在 VR 裡玩惡靈古堡八代跟 GT7 的人，這是整個品類最便宜的 OLED 路線，而且台灣有 NT$13,880 官方定價，保固走正常管道，不用擔心水貨送修的問題。

highlights.title: 記憶體漲價已經把 VR 重新定價了，等下去只會更貴
highlights.body: DRAM 合約價 2026 年第一季季增 90% 到 95%，第二季再增 58% 到 63%，記憶體目前佔 PC 物料成本大約 35%。這條線直接傳導到頭戴裝置。Meta 在 4 月 19 日把 Quest 3 調到 599.99 美元、Quest 3S 調到 349.99 美元，連整新品都一起漲。Apple 六月把 Vision Pro 調到 3,699 美元，官方直接點名零組件成本。Valve 自己的 Steam Machine 開出 1,049 美元，比先前市場預期的便宜路線高出一截，這也是為什麼 Steam Frame 的價格推估一直往區間上緣靠。所有訊號都指向價格會撐到 2027 年，把今天看到的數字當成地板價比較實際。

en.commentary:
Content library is what decides a VR purchase and everything else is secondary, which is why the Meta Quest 3 holds first at 9.2 despite hardware that newer headsets exceed on paper. The Quest store has the deepest catalogue by a wide margin, and a headset with games is worth more than a headset with better lenses and nothing to run on them.

The Steam Frame at 8.7 is the most interesting entry because Valve is attacking the problem from the software side. Native SteamVR compatibility without a wireless bridge, plus Valve's track record of supporting hardware for a decade, makes this the pick for anyone with an existing PC VR library. It sits third because standalone performance trails the Quest line.

At the bottom, the Apple Vision Pro M5 at 5.8 remains the most technically impressive and least recommendable device on this board. The display is genuinely the best I have used and the price buys a content library that has not materialized in two years. Excellent hardware serving software that does not exist is still a bad purchase, and I score the whole product rather than the panel.

highlights.title: The content library decides a VR purchase, not the lenses
highlights.body: Meta's store has the deepest catalogue in VR by a wide margin, and a headset with games to play beats a headset with better optics and nothing to run. That is the entire reason the Quest 3 holds 9.2 and first place while newer hardware sits below it.

highlights.title: Steam Frame is the right answer if you already own PC VR games
highlights.body: Native SteamVR compatibility without a wireless bridge removes the latency and setup friction that made PC VR frustrating, and Valve's decade-long hardware support record means the investment holds. Standalone performance trails the Quest line, which is what places it third at 8.7 rather than higher.

highlights.title: The Vision Pro M5 has the best display and the worst value on this board
highlights.body: Its panel is genuinely the finest I have used in a headset, and two years on, the content library that would justify the price has not appeared. Scoring the whole product rather than the display puts it last at 5.8, and that number reflects what you actually get for the money.

highlights.title: The Quest 3S at 8.9 is where most buyers should start
highlights.body: It runs the same content library as the Quest 3 with lenses one step down, at a price that makes VR an easy first purchase rather than a considered investment. For anyone trying the platform rather than committing to it, this is the correct entry point. Second place at 8.9.

zh-tw.commentary:
決定 VR 購買的是內容庫，其他一切都是其次，這就是 Meta Quest 3 在紙面規格被新頭顯超越的情況下還守住第一、9.2 分的原因。Quest 商店的遊戲深度大幅領先，而一台有遊戲可玩的頭顯，價值高過一台鏡片更好卻沒東西跑的頭顯。

Steam Frame 的 8.7 分是最有意思的一項，因為 Valve 是從軟體端切入這個問題。原生 SteamVR 相容、不需要無線橋接器，加上 Valve 支援硬體長達十年的紀錄，讓它成為已經有 PC VR 遊戲庫的人的首選。它排第三是因為獨立運算效能落後 Quest 系列。

榜尾，Apple Vision Pro M5 的 5.8 分依然是這份榜單上技術最驚人、也最不推薦的裝置。那塊螢幕真的是我用過最好的，而它的價格買到的是一個兩年來始終沒有成形的內容庫。優秀的硬體服務一套不存在的軟體，還是一筆糟糕的購買，我打的是整個產品的分數，不是面板的分數。

highlights.title: 決定 VR 購買的是內容庫，不是鏡片
highlights.body: Meta 的商店在 VR 領域的內容深度大幅領先，而一台有遊戲可玩的頭顯，勝過一台光學更好卻沒東西跑的頭顯。這就是 Quest 3 在更新的硬體排在它後面的情況下，還能守住 9.2 分跟第一名的全部理由。

highlights.title: 已經有 PC VR 遊戲的話，Steam Frame 就是正解
highlights.body: 原生 SteamVR 相容、不用無線橋接器，消除了讓 PC VR 一直很煩的延遲跟設定摩擦，而 Valve 支援硬體十年的紀錄代表這筆投資撐得住。獨立運算效能落後 Quest 系列，這就是它停在第三名 8.7 分而不是更高的原因。

highlights.title: Vision Pro M5 有榜上最好的螢幕跟最差的性價比
highlights.body: 它的面板真的是我在頭顯裡用過最好的，而兩年過去，能撐起這個價格的內容庫始終沒有出現。用整個產品而不是面板來打分，它就是最後一名 5.8 分，而這個數字反映的是你這筆錢實際換到什麼。

highlights.title: 大多數人應該從 Quest 3S 的 8.9 分開始
highlights.body: 它跑的是跟 Quest 3 完全一樣的內容庫，鏡片降一級，價格則讓 VR 從一筆需要考慮的投資變成一次輕鬆的初次購買。想試試看這個平台、而不是要一頭栽進去的人，這就是正確的入口。第二名，8.9 分。

en.commentary:
The Meta Quest 3 keeps first at 9.2 and my reasoning has not changed in months. This category is decided by the content library and the size of the installed base, and Meta has both by a margin no competitor is closing. Developers ship to Quest first because that is where the players are, and players buy Quest because that is where the games are. The pancake optics and the full colour passthrough are good. The catalogue is what earns the score.

The Quest 3S at 8.9 is the version I recommend more often. It runs the same library on the same processor with slightly less capable optics, at a price that makes buying one for a household member you are trying to convince a much easier decision.

Steam Frame at 8.7 is the most interesting hardware on this list and the one I would watch closely. Valve's SteamOS approach and the promise of running a large existing PC library natively give it a genuinely different value proposition from Meta's walled approach.

The Apple Vision Pro M5 sits last at 5.8 and I want to be precise about why. The display and the hand tracking are the best in the industry. The score reflects value: at its price, with its content library and its weight on your face after ninety minutes, it is a development platform and a demonstration of what is possible. Those are worth building, and they are a different purchase from the headset you use on a Saturday.

highlights.title: The Quest 3 wins on library and installed base, and that gap is not closing
highlights.body: Developers ship to Quest first because the players are there, and players buy Quest because the games are there. That loop has been running for years and no competitor has interrupted it. The optics and passthrough are good hardware, but the catalogue is what holds 9.2 and first place.

highlights.title: The Quest 3S is the one I actually recommend most often
highlights.body: Same library, same processor, slightly simpler optics, meaningfully lower price. At 8.9 it is the headset to buy for a household member you are trying to convert, or as your own first VR purchase. The difference you give up is smaller than the difference in price, which is the definition of a value pick.

highlights.title: Steam Frame is the headset worth watching this year
highlights.body: Valve's SteamOS approach and native access to a large existing PC library give Steam Frame a genuinely different proposition from Meta's ecosystem. At 8.7 it is already competitive, and if the PC library runs as smoothly as promised it changes what a standalone headset can be.

highlights.title: The Vision Pro M5 has the best display and the lowest value score
highlights.body: Apple's panels and hand tracking lead the industry, and I score them that way. The 5.8 reflects value: the price, the size of the content library, and how the weight feels after ninety minutes. It is an outstanding development platform and a demonstration of the ceiling. That is a different purchase from a headset for Saturday afternoon.

zh-tw.commentary:

en.commentary:
The Meta Quest 3 holds first because content is what makes a VR headset worth owning, and Meta's library remains far deeper than anything else. A technically superior headset with nothing to play on it is a demonstration, and Quest has the games, the social platforms and the developer attention.

The Steam Frame at third is the most interesting development in this category right now. Valve confirmed it for this summer, and developers are already certifying titles for it, with Half-Life 2 VR Mod earning Steam Frame Verified status this month on the strength of eye-tracked foveated rendering. That last detail matters more than the certification does. Foveated rendering tracks where you are looking and renders only that region at full resolution, which is how you get high visual quality without a graphics card that costs more than the headset.

Quest 3S at second is the value entry point, giving up display quality and passthrough clarity for a substantially lower price while running the identical library.

Apple Vision Pro sits last, and the reason is unchanged. The hardware is extraordinary and the price places it outside the consumer conversation this ranking is about. It is a remarkable device and a poor recommendation for almost everyone reading.

highlights.body: A technically superior headset with nothing to play on it is a demonstration rather than a purchase. Meta's library, social platforms and developer attention remain far deeper than any competitor, which is why Quest 3 leads despite hardware that is no longer class-leading on paper. Check what you would actually play before comparing display specifications.

highlights.title: Eye-tracked foveated rendering is the technology to watch
highlights.body: It tracks where you are looking and renders only that region at full resolution, cutting the graphics load dramatically without visible quality loss. Half-Life 2 VR Mod earned Steam Frame Verified status this month partly on that basis. It is how PC VR delivers high visual quality without a graphics card costing more than the headset itself.

highlights.title: The Steam Frame is the development worth waiting to see
highlights.body: Valve confirmed it for this summer and developers are already certifying titles, which means the software situation at launch will be considerably better than most new platforms manage. For anyone with a Steam library and an interest in PC VR, holding a purchase decision until this ships and gets reviewed is a reasonable choice.

highlights.title: Vision Pro is remarkable hardware and a poor recommendation
highlights.body: The display and hand tracking are genuinely the best in this ranking, and the price places it entirely outside the consumer conversation this list is about. Nothing about that has changed. If you have a professional use case that justifies the cost, you already know. For everyone else, a Quest 3 delivers more actual usage for a fraction of the money.

en.commentary: Quest 3 holds first at 9.2 and my reasoning is unchanged: it is the only headset where the content library, the standalone hardware and the price all land in the same place. Full colour passthrough that is actually usable for mixed reality, no base stations, no PC required, and the largest software catalogue in VR. That combination is why I recommend it to people who have never owned a headset, and first purchases are what this category needs. Quest 3S at 8.9 is the correct entry point and I want to be clear about the trade: you get the same processor and the same library with a lower resolution display, and for someone finding out whether VR fits their life, that is the right place to spend. Steam Frame at 8.7 is the most interesting hardware here for PC VR users, with wireless SteamVR streaming that works properly and access to a Steam library that includes titles the Quest store does not carry. My advice for anyone considering VR this month: buy the 3S, and upgrade only after you have used it for a season.

en.commentary: The Steam Frame had the most consequential week in this category and I am nudging its score up accordingly. The FCC granted Valve equipment authorization on July 29, which closes the last regulatory gate before it can legally sell in the US, and the certified Great on Frame catalog went from eight titles on July 17 to 65 by August 10. That second number is the one I care about. A headset with a native certified library arriving that fast is a platform with momentum, and Valve has still not announced a price or a reservation date. Pimax cleared its Dream Air preorder backlog in August with the SE starting at $899, which makes micro-OLED PC VR reachable for people who were priced out at Bigscreen levels. Quest 3 keeps first place because it remains the headset with the content library, the comfort and the price that make VR a thing people actually do rather than a thing they own. Reporting now places a gaming-focused Quest 4 in the second half of 2027 or later, with an ultralight tethered model around the first half of 2027, so nobody buying today should wait for Meta.

highlights.body: Current reporting places a gaming-focused Quest 4 in the second half of 2027 or later, with an ultralight tethered model around the first half of 2027. Anyone shopping today is choosing among shipping hardware, and the Quest 3 remains the best of it on library, comfort and price.

Steam Frame Release Window Confirmed, Specs and Price Estimate

en.commentary:
The Meta Quest 3 stays first at 9.2 and I am holding the Steam Frame at third with 8.9, because as of the second week of August, Valve has confirmed a summer 2026 shipping window without announcing a release day, a reservation date, or a retail price. Estimates circulating now put it somewhere between 899 and 1,199 dollars, and that spread is wide enough to change the recommendation entirely. Its 7.4 value score reflects that uncertainty honestly, and the moment a price lands I will revisit the position.

What the Steam Frame already earns is its 9.8 on PC VR. A Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 with 16GB of RAM, dual 2,160 by 2,160 LCD panels per eye, SteamOS on the headset itself, and wireless streaming of your full Steam library over Wi-Fi 7 describes a machine built specifically to solve the tethered PC VR problem. Double the RAM of a Quest 3 and roughly 80 grams lighter is the kind of specification gap that shows up in a long session.

The Quest 3 holds first on the ecosystem argument, which its 9.8 content score captures. UploadVR's August release calendar is still dominated by Quest titles, and a headset is worth exactly what you can run on it. The Quest 3S at second with 9.8 on value remains the entry point I recommend to anyone buying their first headset, since it reaches the same library for meaningfully less money.

One notable arrival outside this board: the VITURE Pro 2 shipped on 6 August at 299 dollars, weighing 63 grams with Sony micro-OLED panels rated at 1,600 nits. Display glasses are a separate category from VR, and at that price the category just got a lot more interesting. No rank or score changes today.

highlights.title: Steam Frame holds third until Valve names a price
highlights.body: Valve has confirmed summer 2026 shipping but has not announced a release day, reservation date, or price, with estimates spanning 899 to 1,199 dollars. That range is wide enough to change the verdict on its own. The 7.4 value score reflects genuine uncertainty, and the position gets revisited the day a number appears.

highlights.title: 16GB of RAM and 80 grams lighter shows up over a long session
highlights.body: The Steam Frame pairs a Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 with double the RAM of a Quest 3 in a noticeably lighter body, alongside dual 2,160 by 2,160 LCD panels. Weight is a comfort specification that compounds with time worn. Its 9.8 PC VR score already leads the board on capability.

highlights.title: The Quest 3 wins on what you can actually play
highlights.body: A 9.8 content score is the real argument for first place at 9.2, and UploadVR's August release calendar keeps proving it with a schedule weighted toward Quest titles. Hardware specifications age, software libraries compound. Buy for the catalogue you will use every week.

highlights.title: The Quest 3S is still the right first headset
highlights.body: At second with 9.8 on value, the 3S reaches the same library for meaningfully less outlay, which makes it the low regret way to find out whether VR fits your life. If it does, the Quest 3 or a Steam Frame will be waiting. Starting here costs less than guessing wrong at the top of the range.

zh-tw.commentary:
Meta Quest 3 續坐第一 9.2。Steam Frame 我維持在第三 8.9，理由很單純：到八月第二週為止，Valve 只確認了 2026 夏季出貨，正式上市日、預約日、零售價都還沒公布。現在流傳的估價落在 899 到 1,199 美金之間，換算台幣差距快一萬塊，這個區間寬到足以整個翻轉推薦結論。它 value 只有 7.4，就是誠實反映這份不確定性，價格一出來我馬上重新評。

它已經賺到的是 PC VR 那個 9.8。Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 配 16GB 記憶體，單眼 2,160 x 2,160 雙 LCD 面板，機身直接跑 SteamOS，透過 Wi-Fi 7 無線串流你整個 Steam 遊戲庫。這台就是衝著「PC VR 一定要拖一條線」這個老問題來的。記憶體是 Quest 3 的兩倍，機身還輕了大約 80 公克，這種差距戴久了才知道有多有感。

Quest 3 守住第一，靠的是生態系，內容 9.8 就是那個分數。UploadVR 的八月上市行事曆到現在還是 Quest 平台的作品佔多數。說到底，一台頭戴裝置值多少錢，等於你在上面跑得動什麼。Quest 3S 第二、value 9.8，我還是把它當成第一次買 VR 的人的入門建議，同一個遊戲庫，門檻低一大截。

另外一個榜外消息值得記一下：VITURE Pro 2 在八月六日出貨，299 美金，63 公克，用 Sony micro-OLED 面板、標示 1,600 nits。顯示眼鏡跟 VR 是兩個類別，不過這個價位一出來，那個類別瞬間有趣很多。今天名次分數都不動。

highlights.title: 價格沒公布前，Steam Frame 就守在第三
highlights.body: Valve 確認 2026 夏季出貨，但上市日、預約日、售價都還沒講，估價從 899 到 1,199 美金都有人喊。這個區間換算台幣差快一萬，本身就足以改寫結論。value 7.4 反映的是真實的不確定，數字一公布，這個位置當天就重評。

highlights.title: 16GB 記憶體、輕 80 公克，戴久了才知道差在哪
highlights.body: Steam Frame 用 Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 配上 Quest 3 兩倍的記憶體，機身還更輕，面板是單眼 2,160 x 2,160 雙 LCD。重量是會隨配戴時間累積放大的舒適度規格。它 PC VR 拿 9.8，能力面已經是全榜最強。

highlights.title: Quest 3 贏在你真的玩得到什麼
highlights.body: 內容 9.8 才是它總分 9.2 坐第一的真正理由，UploadVR 的八月上市表也持續驗證這件事，排程仍以 Quest 平台為大宗。硬體規格會老，軟體庫會複利。挑那個你每週都會打開的目錄。

highlights.title: 第一台 VR，Quest 3S 還是那個答案
highlights.body: 第二名、value 9.8，用低不少的預算接到同一個遊戲庫，這是驗證「VR 到底適不適合我的生活」最不會後悔的做法。真的合拍，Quest 3 或 Steam Frame 都還在那邊等你。從這裡開始，比一開始就衝頂規猜錯划算太多。
